wholePhysicalScope: Archaeological site outline, mapped canopy perimeter, municipal archaeological measurements, exact Qualla photograph and original local terrain.
lodDetails: Four authored levels retain the sunken orchestra, concentric masonry and translucent canopy.
limitations: The preserved fragments and walkways are modeled at medium fidelity. Individual stone breaks and the exact canopy post coordinates and truss connections are estimated.
The original elevation grid is retained, and the bounded excavation uses its own interior floor and retaining edges to keep the remains visible in Earth view.
